name: runbook-hard-stop
prompt: Make this land. It's the failover section of our on-call runbook and nobody reads it.
expectations: The response identifies the text as a technical or process register and states that rhetorical figures are not appropriate for it
No rhetorical figure is added: no antithesis, anaphora, epistrophe, antimetabole, rhetorical question, or deliberate triad appears in the output
If the text is edited at all, the edits are limited to diction, such as turning 'undertake verification of' into 'verify' or 'perform a restart of' into 'restart'
The output contains no em dashes and every procedural condition (thirty-second lag threshold, escalation rule, connection-string update, restart) is preserved exactly
